ctx.x: To me, Charles Elgar was a very high-class man. He was one of Eddie South's teachers, a great violinist -- Charles Elgar was a violin player. And he had an orchestra, a very good orchestra. Not a Jazz orchestra, from what I can understand, but a dance orchestra that played nightclubs and played parties. From what I can hear of it, it was... I wasn't old enough to play with him, but I saw him, you know.
